 RAF Abu Dhabi video: Julianna Pena falls by pin in RAF debut to Diana Avsaragova
 Julianna Pena’s RAF debut did not go as expected
 by Damon Martin Nov 14, 2026, 5:26 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Diana Avsaragova rolls against Julianna Pena at RAF Abu Dhabi. RAF Damon Martin is a veteran journalist and insider covering combat sports since 2003. Former UFC champion Julianna Pena did not have the debut she wanted at RAF Abu Dhabi.
 Usually part of the commentary team, Pena finally decided to cross over on the mats but she ultimately suffered a loss by pin to second-time wrestler Diana Avsaragova.
 The match ended after Avsaragova secured a slick throw to put Pena down on the mats and immediately she went up 4-0. A moment later, Avsaragova adjusted her position and pinned Pena’s shoulders to the mat and she had no answer with the referee ending the match a moment later.
 Pena spoke prior to the match how RAF co-founder Chad Bronstein had been imploring her to make the move and step on the wrestling mat but she was undecided on whether nor not she would do it again.
 Given the results on Saturday, Pena might be even more motivated now after a disappointing loss in her debut.
 While wrestling has taken up her time lately, Pena hasn’t addressed when she might return to the octagon as she’s still highly rated in the women’s bantamweight division and UFC 334 on Saturday features a title fight in her division as Kayla Harrison takes on Amanda Nunes.
 Of course, Pena has history with both splitting a pair of fights with Nunes and Harrison taking her title away in her last outing.
